title:
We built an AI that backtests your options strategy from a plain-English sentence (free, NSE data)
- Tired of guessing if my options ideas work, so I made an AI that backtests them — even shows the losers.
author: Quantcents
selftext:
Like a lot of you, I have endless "what if I did X every expiry" options ideas — but actually backtesting them meant Python, messy spreadsheets, or just... never checking.

So we built Quantcents: you describe a strategy in plain English (e.g. "sell a BANKNIFTY iron condor every Friday, exit at 2x credit") and an AI agent walks it through real NSE historical data, trade by trade, and hands back a full report — equity curve, win rate, fees, drawdown, and an honest verdict.

 It shows the strategies that LOSE too, and explains why. One of the demo runs is a NIFTY iron condor that ended down \~1% — because that's the truth, and that's more useful than another "guaranteed profit" tool.

It's free while in beta. You describe an idea, it runs it, you get the report. Would genuinely love feedback from people who trade this stuff — what would you want it to test?Educational/research only, not advice.  
  
Link if anyone wants to try: [agents.quantcents.com](http://agents.quantcents.com)
